basis: Average toll per mile for a 5-axle tractor-trailer (high profile) paying with an electronic tag (E-ZPass / I-PASS / K-TAG / PikePass / SunPass), derived from each agency's published 2026 schedule over the full length of the road. Other axle counts are scaled with axleFactors.
disclaimer: Estimate only. Real tolls depend on the exact entry/exit, time of day, tag vs cash / toll-by-plate (often 25-100% more), the issuing state of the tag, and rate changes. Toll sections and miles come from TomTom; the price is our average-rate estimate, not a quote.

axleFactors.note: Ratio of each high-profile axle class to the 5-axle (5H) class on the 2026 Pennsylvania Turnpike E-ZPass schedule (New Castle to Delaware River Bridge: 2H $81.90, 3H $109.12, 4H $163.68, 5H $218.24, 6H $272.80, 7+H $327.36). 8 and 9 axles are extrapolated (+0.25 per axle); most agencies charge 7+ axles one rate, so 8-9 may be high. Other roads use different ratios (Indiana 2-axle about 0.19, Ohio about 0.57 of 5-axle) - rough on purpose.

generic.note: Used for toll sections in states not listed below (and outside the US): roughly the median of the per-mile rates in this file.
